name: B10-0424/2026 – After § 4 – Am 93
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the need for an EU strategy to counter Islamist entryism and the influence of the Muslim Brotherhood network
part_text: 4b. Calls on the Commission to present a dedicated action plan to fight anti-Muslim racism, as an implementation instrument of the EU Anti-Racism Strategy 2026-2030, with clear objectives, measures and timelines, Commission services responsible, and indicators for monitoring progress; calls for the action plan to address the specific manifestations of anti-Muslim racism across employment, education, housing, healthcare, public services, hate crime and hate speech, with particular attention to the intersection of religion, racialisation and gender, including the multiple and intersecting forms of discrimination faced by Muslim women; calls, furthermore, on the Commission to establish a cross-Commission coordination mechanism bringing together the Coordinator on combating anti-Muslim hatred and the Coordinator on combating racism, under the political oversight of the Commissioner for Equality, to ensure coherence and avoid institutional fragmentation;
